overall: The AG found the Committee is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law because it is not "within" government, so its failure to provide minutes was not a violation.

allegations.summary: Two complaints alleged the Malden Community Fund Committee failed to respond to requests for copies of its meeting minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Because we find that the Committee is not a public body, we also find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by not providing meeting minutes.
